A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete, readable 29-page paper, including Appendices A.1–A.9. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that only the first-page arXiv version/date stamp differs.

before.justification: v2 reports original rotation-control and robotics experiments using PPO, SAC and TD3 in Sections 3–4, Table 2 and Figures 4–6, with further experiments and ablations in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results, including Table 2, the robotics benchmarks in Figures 4–6, and the appendix experiments and ablations.

M1.justification: The action representations, projection procedures, tangent scaling, unit-centering variants and algorithm-specific handling are identical, including their appendix implementations.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same idealized rotation environment, drone trajectory tracking and racing, nine RoboSuite tasks, and ReachOrient/PickAndPlaceOrient tasks. No domains, tasks or test scenarios change.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every experiment. Both retain the matrix, quaternion, tangent and Euler comparisons, together with Zhou et al. (2019)'s 6D representation in Appendix A.4.

E3.justification: Sections 3–4 and Appendices A.7–A.8 report identical environment dynamics, rewards, metrics, training budgets, network architectures and hyperparameter tuning procedures.

E4.justification: Section 3.3 and Appendices A.1 and A.3 retain identical analyses of projections, exploration, entropy, tangent scaling, conflicting gradients and unit-centering. No ablations or supplementary analyses are added or removed.

E5.justification: Run counts and uncertainty reporting are identical, including 50 runs in Section 3.2, 25 seeds in Figure 4 and five seeds in Figure 5. The same standard-deviation bands and error bars remain.

E6.justification: Table 2 and all main-text and appendix result figures are unchanged. For example, SAC with dense rewards and local tangent actions scores -2.9 ± 0.3 in both versions. No numerical results, rankings or qualitative findings change.

T1.justification: The SO(3) definition, projection and dynamics equations, unit-centering formulas and Appendix A.6 entropy argument are identical. No mathematical reasoning or formal assumptions are revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical contributions and claims about representation-dependent exploration, optimization and the general reliability of local tangent actions.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and applicability qualifications are unchanged. Section 5 retains the same limitations and discussion concerning state-based observations, small networks, discrete actions, benchmark coverage and diffusion policies.

D1.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendices A.5, A.7 and A.8 retain identical code-access information, implementation listings, environment specifications, architectures and tuning details.

R1.justification: The reference list and research positioning are identical, including the relationships to supervised rotation-representation studies and prior reinforcement-learning work.

P1.justification: The first-page margin stamp changes from arXiv:2510.11103v2 dated 21 Feb 2026 to arXiv:2510.11103v3 dated 26 Jun 2026. All manuscript wording, headings, section ordering and appendix structure remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–32, Tables 1–3, code listings, captions and layout are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–29 are pixel-identical; page 1 differs only in the version/date stamp text.

improvement.justification: v3 retains the same scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations, reproducibility information and limitations throughout the main text and appendices. The sole version/date stamp update has no meaningful effect on overall paper quality.
